newsitem.title: USA: Excite names Desrosier EVP of marketing.
newsitem.headline: Excite names Desrosier EVP of marketing.

text.p: Excite Inc. said Monday it has named James Desrosier to the post of executive vice president of marketing to secure the Internet search and navigation company's position as a free online service.
Desrosier was previously vice president and chief marketing officer at Infoseek Corp., another Internet search business which has been going through a management reshuffle.
Before joining Infoseek, Desrosier was senior vice president of marketing at MasterCard International, where he defined strategic marketing initiatives.

"The thing that Excite has been doing right and continues to do right is to look at the online information services business from a much bigger picture standpoint," Desrosier said in an interview. "As the search engines started to add feeds and specialised content, they take on a different complexion, they become information services."

Desrosier, 42, said he aims to convert each of the visitors to Excite's services on the Internet, which he said roughly amount to around two million individuals a day currently, into "a steady, regular, consistent, deep user of the service."
